settings:
# Exploratory follow-up of 12.11.2026 (course folder pro/followup-2026-11-12/plan.md), chosen after the main
# results and two reviews. Not in the plan; decides no hypothesis. Bars and predictions below were
# written before the run. "Reduction" is the relative error reduction of the main report.
#
# N4, bias and variance. The 11 datasets with at least 4,000 outer-training rows, seed 0. Each
# outer-training set is dealt into 4 disjoint draws of 1,000 rows; every draw trains a model that predicts
# the same test rows. The spread of the 4 predictions of a test row is the variance part of the squared
# error (class probabilities in classification); the rest is bias and noise. 4 x 3 x 11 x 5 = 660 tasks.
#
# Bar:
# - V1 added columns raise the variance: the variance part of residual_xx is above the base cascade's on
#   at least 9 of 11 datasets. The same for target_noise_xx. Prediction: no for residual_xx, open for
#   noise. V1 is the instructor's remark (the method can represent more, so it may overfit) as a test.
datasets = ["page_blocks", "parkinsons", "air_quality", "ccpp", "phishing", "bike_sharing", "bank_marketing",
            "adult", "credit_default", "california", "superconductivity"]
seeds = [0]
outer_folds = 5

[[check]]
name = "d0"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { train_rows = 1000, train_draws = 4, train_draw = 0 }

[[check]]
name = "d1"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { train_rows = 1000, train_draws = 4, train_draw = 1 }

[[check]]
name = "d2"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { train_rows = 1000, train_draws = 4, train_draw = 2 }

[[check]]
name = "d3"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { train_rows = 1000, train_draws = 4, train_draw = 3 }
